from pathlib import Path
import json, os, platform, subprocess, sys, time, uuid
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve()
assert (ROOT/'all55_fast_diagnostic.py').is_file(), '请合并本补丁到full_model_test'
assert platform.system()=='Linux' and platform.machine().lower() in ('armv7l','armv8l')
RUN=ROOT/'test_results'/('compatible_all55_fast_'+uuid.uuid4().hex)
RUN.mkdir(parents=True)
def execute_stage(stage):
    destination=RUN/stage
    destination.mkdir()
    command=[sys.executable,'-u','-B',str(ROOT/'all55_fast_diagnostic.py'),'--stage',stage,'--output',str(destination)]
    if stage=='fpga':
        gate=RUN/'cpu/correctness.json'
        assert gate.is_file(), '请先完成本Notebook的CPU格'
        value=json.loads(gate.read_text())
        assert value.get('diagnostic_completed') and value.get('software_reconstruction_gate'), 'CPU重建失败，不加载FPGA'
        command+=['--cpu-report',str(gate)]
    logfile=destination/'execution.log'
    print('开始:',stage,'日志:',logfile,flush=True)
    with logfile.open('w',encoding='utf-8') as writer:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=str(ROOT),text=True,stdout=writer,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','PYTHONUNBUFFERED':'1'})
        deadline=time.monotonic()+1800
        try:
            with logfile.open('r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as reader:
                while True:
                    chunk=reader.read()
                    if chunk:
                        print(chunk,end='',flush=True)
                    returncode=proc.poll()
                    if returncode is not None:
                        tail=reader.read()
                        if tail:
                            print(tail,end='',flush=True)
                        break
                    if time.monotonic()>deadline:
                        proc.kill()
                        proc.wait()
                        returncode=-1
                        print('\n本阶段超过1800秒，已停止。请返回日志。',flush=True)
                        if stage=='fpga':
                            print('若发生硬件超时或IP仍忙，请重启板卡后再继续。',flush=True)
                        break
                    time.sleep(2)
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.kill()
                proc.wait()
    print('\n返回码:',returncode,'结果目录:',destination,flush=True)
    assert returncode==0, '本阶段未完成，请返回完整输出，不继续下一格'
print('本次结果目录:',RUN)
execute_stage('cpu')
execute_stage('fpga')
